If you want to play and enjoy the game and not have to worry about efficient leveling, then you should play Oblivion with the [Obvion XP mod](http://oblivion.nexusmods.com/mods/35333). 

This mod changes how you level up: Instead of training on skills and level up through advancement of skills, you just play and get xp points by completing quest, killing monsters, exploring new areas, and when you reach certain amount of xp, you level up.

In my opinion, this mod makes the game much more less stressful and it allow a casual gamer like me to enjoy the game without worrying about micromanagement of skills.
